name: off-terminating-batch-keeps-receipt-no-reset
description: official-host.ts:1301 'native terminating batch keeps its receipt without a reset or unsolicited request'. A tool result with terminate:true ends the run: no reset, no further model request (the script's second turn would be consumed by an unsolicited request and starve the next prompt); the next prompt's response (usage 150,105 tokens: the 600k-char receipt is in its prompt) makes Pi start the threshold compaction after the run, so exactly one boundary commits with no summary request and no unsolicited continuation.
